tooling: NAT KVM with 20 forwarded ports, root over SSH on a non-standard port, IPv6 /64 or /80, no individual support - all questions go to the community thread.

superseded.notes: The honesty of this operator is the notable part: it publishes RAID0 with no backups and no term guarantee on its own front page. The 250 GB a month is metered, unlike BoxyBSD's discretionary fair use, so the failure mode is arithmetic rather than a support decision. Funding is explicit: the thirteen hypervisors are donated by named hosts, GTHost, Crunchbits, Scaleblade and others, which is why the fleet survives when one sponsor leaves.
